clips.text: What does the seed know of its own potential?
It is the same with man: he doesn't know what he is nor what he can be!
The seed, perhaps, cannot look within but man can.
This looking in is called meditation.
To know one's truth as it is here and now is meditation.
Dive into it, deeper and deeper; there, in the depths, all that is possible can be clearly seen.
And once seen it begins to happen - the awareness of what is possible turns it into a reality, like a seed stirred by a vision of its potential beginning to sprout.
Time, effort, energy - pour it all into meditation because meditation is the gateless gate through which the self becomes aware of itself.
